interpretation: All 18 AC1024 DWGs in the LibreDWG 2010-labelled directory and all 10 AC1024 DWGs in the historical Autodesk sample collection reach dwgReader24::readDwgClasses END with no CLASSES CRC mismatch. This fails to reproduce the reported six-of-ten behavior but does not disprove it because per-file AutoCAD 2010 RTM producer provenance is absent and the exact failing input/hash is unknown. Keep the issue unresolved; do not alter the parser based on these passing candidates.
fixturePolicy: All acquired DWGs remain in /private/tmp. No external DWG/DXF was added to the repository.
